name: Note
description: Jot something down; saved automatically to widget storage
author: Lattice

sections.title: Just start typing
items: Click into the card and type. There is no save button — the text is written 400 ms after you stop.
Clicking away, or the card being hidden, saves at once instead of waiting for that pause.
It also types inside a desktop window, where the window itself never takes focus.

sections.title: The status line
items: Unsaved means there are keystrokes not on disk yet. Saving… is a write in flight. Saved means it is down.
If a write fails the line says so and your text stays in the card; the next keystroke retries.
A missing storage permission is named outright — the note keeps working until the card reloads.

sections.title: The character count
items: It counts characters, not words, so you can see how much room is left before the line wraps.
Hover the status line when it is truncated to read the full message.

sections.title: One note, several cards
items: Every Note widget shows the same text — they are views of one note, not separate notes.
If you want a second note, install a copy under a different id.

changes: First release: type and it saves, with a status line and a character count.
Editing works inside a desktop window that never takes focus.
The text area keeps clear of the window buttons, so no line hides underneath them.
